body:
Yeah sorry the example is not great but favorite food is indeed user submitted text. 

We cannot use facets in there. We have two search boxes in the UI yes, that lead to two query string properties, but only one resultset in the UI, we cannot split the results in two panels for instance.

We could normalize those foods. We discussed it and found another problem but I can't remember it. It's still a possible solution though, but it is not what we want.

We are also discussing using weighted results instead, searching "foo" in favorite foods but with much less score impact.

And yes, I guess the Algolia team could help us on that!
